reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and no redline or comment was proposed — consistent with the expectation that compliant findings are recorded as evidence rather than raised as negotiation issues.

The cited paragraphs (Section 9.2 no transfer/lien, Section 5.7 no division, Section 9.5 no petition) are structural securitization covenants; none restricts the businesses our side may operate or the products it may buy or build, so they correctly fall outside the NONCOMPETE rule's scope per the detection guidance.

Rationale documents a reasonable negative search ("compet", "exclusiv", "solicit", "territory", "shall not engage") and identifies the plausible clause homes (Articles IX and X), supporting the conclusion that no field-of-use or non-compete restriction exists anywhere in the document.
Deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains; the rendered text is unchanged from the original, as appropriate for a compliant finding.
